headline: EPS rises steadily on both comparisons
summary_short: TOMONY Holdings reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥34.16, up 25.4% y/y from ¥27.25.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥34.16 rose 25.4% year-over-year from ¥27.25, and was up 9.6% sequentially from ¥31.16 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
